title: [Menu] No highlight for selected value by default
body: When an item is selected in the menu widget, there is no visual clue that anything is selected.

comments.body: To me a safe bet would be to add an `em` tag around selected options in the `refinement-list` and `menu` templates.
The default menu widget can embed em tags by default that should do it
`em` or `strong` would work yes I guess :)
We should add a CSS class to the current selected element instead of adding markup to it. This will fall under the whole BEM refactoring that is planned.

Indeed but then the default template will still not emphasis what's the selected element. We can have `<em>` AND a bem class added to it?

Can you explain what do you plan for #47 (inside the issue). So that we can see what we are going to do exactly.

We are already adding custom CSS in other widgets (poweredBy for example). We should do the same here for the critical stuff (like emphasis on default templates). Adding a new markup element makes all CSS rules more complex and is not needed.
We are adding a `ais-widgetname--item__active` to the active item.
